about_the_game:
Dark Reaper Shoots! 2 is a new sequel to the smartphone game Dark Reaper Shoots!, which previously recorded 5.30 million downloads.

Overcome relentless attacks and dominate the battlefield

Defeat enemies to collect skills and acquire more powerful abilities. Skill combinations can lead to significant power-ups! Customize your style to your liking and bring victory to your side.

Collect materials in various stages

Strengthen yourself with materials obtained from the stages and advance to new, unseen stages. In addition to the skill tree, you can enhance your abilities and acquire special skills by crafting weapons and masks.

Let's Power Up Your Partner, Gawgaw!

Gawgaw is the familiar and loyal companion of the lonely Grim Reaper. Despite its cute appearance, it's a powerful support character that can easily defeat numerous enemies.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Streaming and Video Content Guidelines:

We welcome both corporate and individual creators to live stream and post gameplay videos.
No prior permission or application is required, so please feel free to stream and share your videos!
Including the link to our Store Page in your video description or overview would be greatly appreciated and highly encouraging for the development team!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
